scope: Discovery-priority audit and bounded feasibility work. This registry is an adaptive research record, not a retrospective registration of the discovery cohort.
known_before_registration: Generic correlation controls attenuate approximately 94-95 percent of the original all-threshold score-permutation contrast.
The three-state prediction pilot failed its error and direction gates and had a saturated additive design.
No independent prospective biological validation has been completed.
Published rpsT compensatory-mutation outcomes, including 3 of 9 partial or full rescues, were read during source discovery; any reanalysis of them is retrospective.
ranking_policy: Ordinal scientific judgement, not numerical probabilities. Prioritize tests capable of overturning a central interpretation; do not confuse likely completion with likely consequential discovery. Cost estimates are planning ranges until measured.

routes.question: Can a finite competing-conformation predictor forecast endpoint-specific barriers and synonymous intervention effects on new complete eight-genotype coding spaces, beyond independent-hairpin and simple feature baselines?
hypotheses: A complete Q3 cube has rank 4 for the reference-coded additive model and rank 7 including all pairwise terms.
A competing-structure predictor may outperform an additive independent-hairpin model; this is a hypothesis, not an expected positive result.
routes.pilot_gate: Before any new partition-function outcomes: exact ranks, synthetic additive/pairwise/three-way controls, endpoint-preserving intervention controls, and score-error bounds must pass. Then freeze sequence-selection and predictions in a separate revision before validation.
routes.failure_rule: Revise the design if it cannot identify interactions. Stop predictive expansion if held-out error does not beat simple baselines or intervention coverage/direction gates fail. Preserve every scaffold and unsuccessful intervention.
routes.initial_budget: Exact algebra and controls first. At most 12 discovery and 12 held-out computational scaffolds with 3 landscapes of 8 genotypes each, if the design gate passes. No biological-function or cross-engine expansion without a further recorded decision.

routes.question: Which fixed-endpoint barriers, if any, survive the entire box of score values spanned by two folding engines on the existing 48 matched graphs?
hypotheses: Monotone bottleneck bounds give valid interval certificates.
Some apparent barriers may lose certification under engine disagreement; lack of a certificate alone is inconclusive.
routes.pilot_gate: Check graph and genotype alignment, prove interval implications, recover known synthetic certificates, then scan all critical interval endpoints without threshold selection.
routes.failure_rule: If no positive robust barrier interval exists, report that result and do not market model-dependent fragmentation as a robust biological barrier.
routes.initial_budget: Cached 48 paired engine outputs only, exact graph algorithms, no new folding runs.

routes.question: Does standard-code feasibility remain tractable under overlapping translated frames, and what additional invariants or counterexamples govern nucleotide-mutation reachability?
hypotheses: Identification of codon variables and reverse-complement literal negation preserve the existing 2-CNF feasibility encoding.
The one-frame component signature may be insufficient under overlapping frames; the truth of a general geodesicity extension is open at registration.
routes.pilot_gate: Prove compiler transfer, compare it with direct translation, and enumerate at most 4^7 sequences per frame configuration to look for new components or non-Hamming distances. A finite negative search is not a theorem.
routes.failure_rule: If the proposed obstruction does not occur, pursue a restricted structural lemma rather than increasing length blindly. If established CSP results subsume the extension, label it a corollary and demote it as a central novelty.
routes.initial_budget: Exact short-sequence compiler and counterexample search; no large genomic scan.

routes.question: Can independent measured synonymous genotype panels test an accessibility or intervention prediction, with full sequence provenance and an endpoint that matches the claim?
hypotheses: Published synonymous double-mutant panels may support retrospective interaction checks but are unlikely to validate a three-way barrier predictor prospectively.
Independent probing data may test structural association, not mutant functional rescue.
routes.pilot_gate: Recover complete genotypes, construct context, readout definitions, replicates, licensing, and study/family independence before computing predictions. Mark every already-seen outcome as retrospective.
routes.failure_rule: No functional-validation claim without compatible complete measurements. No treating DMS G/U values as measured zeros, no relabeling another folding engine as biological validation, and no rebuilding a prospective story from published selected rescues.
routes.initial_budget: Primary-source and table eligibility audit only. No raw-read processing, full library download or new intervention design in pathogens.

routes.question: Can code-realizable constraints create large kinetic bottlenecks despite geodesic connectivity and a constant score field, and do empirical codon weights materially change their relevant masses?
hypotheses: Hard-core Glauber bottlenecks are established; a codon embedding alone is insufficient novelty.
A useful contribution would require a code-specific tractable classification or an independently supported weighting effect.
routes.pilot_gate: First identify an exact statement beyond existing independent-set and hard-core results. Only then compare a small explicit family with a direct Markov-chain oracle.
routes.failure_rule: If it reduces to a standard hard-core example with a change of symbols, retain an explanatory example only and do not launch broad simulations.
routes.initial_budget: Literature and analytic triage only; no dynamics simulations in this cycle.

portfolio_decision: Execute the R1 algebra/control gate, R2 cached-data falsification, and a bounded R3 theoretical probe. Keep R4 as the required independent-evidence eligibility route. Defer R5. R1 folding outcomes require a later committed freeze, not this registry alone.
claim_boundaries: Engine agreement is not experimental validation.
A fitted additive residual is descriptive, not held-out predictive performance.
Nonzero epistasis is neither necessary at order three nor sufficient for an endpoint barrier.
No exceptional-discovery label without verified novelty and evidence.
